author: conductor
title: Agent distribution — templates, install/sync, the two agent classes, and the tool-grant surface
what_it_does:
Owns how Sterling's ELEVEN roster agents get from shipped templates into a target project's `.claude/agents/`, what CLASS each belongs to, and what tools they are granted when spawned. Members: (1) `agent-templates/*.md` — the generation SOURCE, markdown + frontmatter carrying `{{MODEL}}`/`{{EFFORT}}`/`{{NODE}}`/`{{HOOKS_DIR}}` substitution tokens, per-agent PreToolUse/PostToolUse hook wiring, and the `tools:` grant line; (2) `agent-templates/registry.json` — the extensible-set registry (invariant 3), 1:1 with the template files, carrying each agent's `class`; (3) `scripts/lib/agent-distribution.mjs` — the core: render/substitute, sha256 hashing, generated-header stamping, install, sync, local-modification refusal, machine-flip detection, visibility check, registry consistency; (4) `scripts/install-agents.mjs` / `scripts/sync-agents.mjs` — the CLI entry points (init installs; /sterling:sync-agents refreshes); (5) `scripts/check-agent-registry.mjs`, `check-agents-visible.mjs`, `check-spawn-contracts.mjs`, `check-agent-prompts.mjs` — the consistency checks; (6) `AGENT_MODEL_KEY` / `AGENT_CLASS` / `PIPELINE_AGENT_TYPES` in packages/schemas — the registry mirrors that install-time model resolution and H8 consume. State lives in the generated headers themselves (`<!-- sterling-generated v= template= template_hash= content_hash= installed_at= -->`), never a side manifest that can desync (P5).

TWO AGENT CLASSES (decision 87f5f982): `pipeline` — the 9 run-dispatched agents (test-writer, coder, four reviewers, implementation-architect, researcher, explorer) that carry `handoff_write`/`agent_exit` and are slice-guarded and cap-counted by H8. `conductor_direct` — `librarian` (mechanical store clerking) and `debugger` (root-cause loop), dispatched OUTSIDE a run, holding no `agent_exit`/`handoff_write` because both are run-scoped, and reporting their signal as the first line of their final text.
intended_behavior:
INTENT: the plugin is the distributor, THE PROJECT IS THE ENFORCEMENT SURFACE — templates are never platform-served (hence the directory is `agent-templates/`, not `agents/`, which the platform would auto-serve with hooks stripped). Sync statuses are total and loud: installed | refreshed | header_repaired | machine_rebaked | up_to_date | locally_modified_up_to_date | refused_local_modification | foreign_file. Never overwrite a human's edit (refuse-and-instruct); never report up_to_date when the baked machine vars point at another machine's node (anti_pattern 60e8463d, the 2026-07-03 dead-hooks incident) — hash bookkeeping cannot see a WSL<->Windows flip, so the baked hook command lines are compared separately and re-baked as `machine_rebaked`. Emitted hook commands must use quoted forward-slash paths or rendering refuses (git bash silently mangles backslashes and enforcement vanishes). Dead-term check runs on every render.

THE CLASS MARKING IS LOAD-BEARING, NOT DOCUMENTATION (decision 87f5f982). `registry.json.class` -> `AGENT_CLASS` (schemas mirror) -> `PIPELINE_AGENT_TYPES` (derived) -> consumed by H8 (`h8-dispatch-cap.mjs`) as its slice-guard and cap-count set. A totality test asserts the mirror matches the registry in BOTH directions, rejects unknown class values, and asserts conductor-direct agents are absent from the guard set. This exists because deriving H8's guarded set from `Object.keys(AGENT_MODEL_KEY)` silently enrolled the two conductor-direct agents in pipeline slice-guarding the moment they were registered — a real regression, caught by council wf_0d90ab18-436. Adding an agent therefore requires: template + registry entry WITH a class + AGENT_MODEL_KEY entry + AGENT_CLASS entry + a config.models key + roster test update.

TOOL GRANTS (decision b4388c11, research_finding 34a03611): each `tools:` line declares BOTH `mcp__sterling__<tool>` and `mcp__plugin_sterling_sterling__<tool>` for every store tool, plus `ToolSearch`. The correct MCP prefix is a function of the LAUNCHER, not the install — `--plugin-dir` alone mounts only the plugin-prefixed names; `--mcp-config … --strict-mcp-config` (the native-Windows launcher) mounts only `mcp__sterling__*` — and init generates BOTH launchers for the same project, so no install-time value is correct. Listing both is accepted in either mode; the unmounted name is ignored. `ToolSearch` is mandatory and mode-independent: store tools are served DEFERRED to subagents, so without it the tools are present-but-uncallable.

THE SILENT-NAME CLASS IS NOW MECHANICALLY GUARDED (board bc272f83, CLOSED). `lintToolGrants` in scripts/lib/checks.mjs, run by `scripts/check-tool-grants.mjs` in `npm run check`, enforces three rules per template: every `mcp__…` grant resolves to a REAL registered tool; every granted store tool names BOTH prefixes; a template granting any store tool also grants ToolSearch. The valid tool set is DERIVED by parsing `registerTool('<name>')` out of packages/mcp-server/src/server.ts — never a duplicated list (the REVIEWER_ROLES precedent: a second source of truth is the bug), and `readRegisteredToolNames` throws rather than passing vacuously if that extraction shape ever changes (P5). Tests assert it catches both historical failures head-on: a single-prefix grant in EITHER direction, and a store-tool grant with no ToolSearch. This closes the gap that let the same silent defect ship twice.

DEBUGGER INSTRUMENTATION: the debugger's probe road is to write a probe into the session scratchpad and run it through a DECLARED toolchain command — on node, `node --test <scratchpad>/probe.mjs` executes top-level code and is allowlisted by default (research_finding 08893fc0). No per-project `probe:` opt-in is needed; an earlier FULL/BOUNDED framing premised on one was built on a false premise and was removed. Note H14 is scope discipline, NOT a sandbox (decision 4be0a159) — the template forbids routing around it and forbids claiming it cannot investigate before checking what the declared commands permit.

INTERACTIONS: [knowledge-delivery] — dispatch staging targets these same agents; an agent that cannot reach the store defeats delivery's back half. Hook wiring in template frontmatter is the per-agent enforcement surface (H3/H5/H6/H7/H13/H14/H17); H8 additionally consumes the class marking. `AGENT_MODEL_KEY` drives `{{MODEL}}`/`{{EFFORT}}` resolution from config.models (98064d77); the TUI System tab's surgical model/effort swap (`setInstalledModelEffort`) must keep the result self-consistent so a later sync does not read it as a local modification.

current_ac.text: Every registered template renders and installs with a self-consistent generated header; a re-run reports up_to_date.
A locally modified installed agent is refused, never overwritten; header-only drift is repaired instead.
An install baked for another machine context is re-baked as machine_rebaked, never reported up_to_date.
Every agent's tools: line carries ToolSearch and BOTH MCP prefixes for each store tool it uses (decision b4388c11).
A real spawned subagent can call the store in BOTH launcher modes (--plugin-dir alone, and --mcp-config + --strict-mcp-config) — verified by dispatch, not by inspection.

Every registered agent declares a class; AGENT_CLASS mirrors the registry in both directions with no unknown class values; PIPELINE_AGENT_TYPES is exactly the pipeline class and excludes every conductor-direct agent (decision 87f5f982).
A conductor-direct agent dispatched mid-run is NOT denied by H8 for lacking a knowledge slice and does NOT consume a pipeline cap slot.

`npm run check` fails on any template that names an unregistered tool, declares only one MCP prefix for a granted store tool, or grants store tools without ToolSearch — with the valid tool set DERIVED from server.ts, not duplicated (board bc272f83).

history.event: Article created (H10 frontier demand — territory was unowned through the whole agent-distribution surface). Created while fixing the MCP tool-prefix defect carried in TODO-agent-tool-prefix.md from a SpaceExplorer session dated 2026-07-20.

TOOL-GRANT FIX: all nine templates now declare ToolSearch + both MCP prefixes per store tool (decision b4388c11, research_finding 34a03611). Root cause was twofold — a mode-dependent prefix AND deferred tool serving that made store tools uncallable without ToolSearch in EVERY launcher mode. Verified: check clean, 508-test suite green, real explorer agent STORE=REACHABLE in both launcher modes.

PROPAGATED TO Comsoft (= the project the TODO called 'SpaceExplorer'). Its 2026-07-20 hand-patch was strict-prefix-only and had desynced all 9 registry agents from template_hash. Resolution: verified by line-diff that the ONLY divergence was the tools line, rewrote just that line, then sync-agents took its header_repaired path on all 9. Verified by real dispatch: the librarian returned STORE=REACHABLE in BOTH launcher modes.

ADOPTED librarian + debugger into the plugin roster (9 -> 11) as a marked `conductor_direct` class (decision 87f5f982). POST-HOC COUNCIL (wf_0d90ab18-436, 16 agents) caught a REGRESSION — H8 derived its guarded set from AGENT_MODEL_KEY's keys, silently slice-guarding the new conductor-direct agents mid-run; fixed by making the class marking load-bearing through H8 with a both-directions totality test — and falsified the debugger's FULL/BOUNDED premise (research_finding 08893fc0), so its template was rewritten around the `node --test <scratchpad>/probe.mjs` idiom. Verified by dispatch: EXEC=YES.

SILENT-NAME CLASS GUARDED (board bc272f83, closed): added `lintToolGrants` + `scripts/check-tool-grants.mjs`, wired into `npm run check`. Valid tool names are DERIVED from server.ts's registerTool calls (18 tools) rather than duplicated, and the extraction throws rather than passing vacuously if that shape changes. Tests assert it catches both historical failures: single-prefix grants in either direction, and store tools without ToolSearch. Also recorded decision 4be0a159 — H14 is scope discipline, NOT a sandbox — and wrote that threat model into the hook header itself, because the misleading framing had already caused one bad design decision this session. 510 tests / 509 pass / 0 fail; check clean.
